common_concerns: Confirming a Melbourne smart-lock installer actually travels to Brighton — three of the ten records are service-area listings that name Brighton explicitly, and one is a dedicated coverage page ('Service Areas | Melbourne Smart Lock Installation', smartlocksmelbourne.au/pages/service-areas-smart-lock-installation, which runs Beaumaris, Bentleigh East, Bentleigh, Black Rock, Braeside, Brighton, Carnegie). thesmartlockshop.com.au/smart-lock-installation-melbourne files Brighton under a 'Bayside & Peninsula' heading with Sandringham, Elwood, Beaumaris and Mentone rather than under its inner- or south-eastern lists, and lockmart.com.au/locks-and-systems/digital-locks scopes itself to 'Melbourne's Mornington Peninsula, Bayside & Casey'. Brighton buyers are being sold on coverage first, so the page has to settle the travel question outright.

Which smart lock brand to buy, and whether the installer has actually fitted that one before — the Melbourne field competes on brand breadth. smartlockinstallation.com.au claims 'all smart lock brands' and lists Bosch, Philips, Aqara, Kaadas, Klug, Lenovo, Sharp, Solity, Eufy, Samsung, August, Yale, Lockwood, Schlage, Lockly, Lemaar, Lane, Kwikset, Xiaomi, Kogan, Orion, AusLock, SDL, DDL, Moorgen, Ezviz and McGrath; the same brand's Facebook page narrows the boast to 'deep experience of Samsung, Aqara, Kaadas, Eufy, Klug' (facebook.com/SmartLockInstallation); lockmart.com.au leads with 'McGrath, Lockwood, Yale & More'. amberpro.com.au/smart-lock-installation-melbourne exists purely to resolve the choice — 'Expert guidance on Yale, August, Schlage, and more. Find the best fit for your home security.'

What the job costs and how to compare offers before committing — airtasker.com/au/services/lock-installation/melbourne fronts '141 local Lock Installation services in Melbourne' with 'FREE quotes in minutes from reviewed, rated & trusted lock installers', and amberpro.com.au is framed as 'Compare top smart lock installers in Melbourne'. Two of the ten records are comparison or quote-marketplace intermediaries rather than installers, so Brighton demand is currently being routed through price comparison and third-party ratings.

Being able to use the lock once it is on the door — smartlocksmelbourne.au/pages/installation-service treats handover as part of the job: 'Once installed, we'll guide you through your new smart lock's features, setting up your fingerprints, user codes, Ic cards.' That is three separate credential types (fingerprint enrolment, numeric user codes, IC cards) a buyer expects to be walked through, and smartlocksmelbourne.au's home page specialises in 'providing and installing fingerprint and smart locks' — so fingerprint setup in particular is a published expectation in this catchment, not an afterthought.
